d: Deep teal, shoulder-length hair with jagged layers and long bangs that partially obscure the face. Narrow, drooping eyes in a muted shade of greyish-blue, paired with a mature, youthful face and a slender build. The outfit consists of a tan ribbed shirt under a white asymmetrical wrap-around chest piece secured by black straps and silver buckles, topped with a loose dark navy oversized jacket and a dark navy beanie with a small gold emblem. Signature details include large black headphones worn around the neck, a small circular blue badge on the lapel, and a black ID badge clipped to the chest.
